title: Sebastian and the Confession
author: Gideon Dunmore
blurb: Astrid Underhill, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has spent ten years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
